title: Correct final distance
description: Essential Criteria: The student's final numerical answer for the total distance on the inclined track must be 20 m.

title: Energy balance setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the work-energy theorem, equating the initial gravitational potential energy to the work done against friction on the incline.

title: Correct height difference
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the effective vertical drop for the incline segment, accounting for the block's starting height and the height of the circular arc's starting point.

title: Friction force expression
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly express the friction force on the incline as μ * m * g * cos(60°) and relate it to the work done over distance s.

title: Trigonometric values
description: Optional Criteria: The student correctly uses cos(60°) = 0.5 and sin(60°) = √3/2 where needed in the geometry or force components.

title: Units in final answer
description: Optional Criteria: The student includes the correct unit (meters) with the final numerical distance.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign error in the work-energy equation, incorrectly adding or subtracting the friction work term.

title: Incorrect arc height
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly calculates the height of the circular arc's starting point, for example by using the full radius R instead of R(1 - cos60°).
